@GreenStixV2 @cronos_chain @cryptocom while Cronos supports layer-2 tokens, Dogecoin does not. Where, layer-2 tokens provide the capability for developers to build decentralised ecosystems on top of the base blockchain protocol, e.g. DeFi (decentralised finance).
